info.title: HarvestSlot API
info.description:
Authoritative REST API for HarvestSlot. Browser sessions use an HttpOnly `hs_session` cookie.

State-changing requests must send `X-CSRF-Token` equal to the `hs_csrf` cookie (call `GET /auth/csrf` first).

Consequential operations require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }`.

Stable error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED (422), BAD_REQUEST (400), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), INVALID_CREDENTIALS (401), MFA_REQUIRED (401), FORBIDDEN (403), CSRF_FAILED (403), ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (403), ORG_NOT_APPROVED (403), DELEGATION_SCOPE_MISSING (403), NOT_FOUND (404), VERSION_CONFLICT (409), INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION (409), CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (409), SUPPLY_EXCEEDED (409), HOLD_EXPIRED (409), OFFER_EXPIRED (409), TERMS_CHANGED (409), SLOT_OVERLAP (409), CAPACITY_BELOW_COMMITTED (409), VEHICLE_CONFLICT (409), DRIVER_CONFLICT (409), NOT_READY (409), OVERPAYMENT (409), INVOICE_DISPUTED (409), OVER_TOLERANCE (409), DUPLICATE (409), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), VEHICLE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (422), QUANTITY_MISMATCH (422), HANDOVER_CODE_INVALID (422), TOKEN_INVALID (400), UPLOAD_REJECTED (422), PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (413), RATE_LIMITED (429), ACCOUNT_LOCKED (429), HANDOVER_CODE_LOCKED (429), INTEGRATION_NOT_CONFIGURED (503), PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (503), PROVIDER_ERROR (502), INTERNAL_ERROR (500).

Quantities are decimal strings in kilograms (3 dp); money is integer kobo; timestamps are UTC ISO-8601.
